value.rationale: Simultaneous local consecutive-pattern frequencies are fundamental observables in random-permutation local-limit models; the limiting polytope has dimension four but does not quantify finite-sample stochastic noise or degeneracy. The theorem determines exactly the five available finite-sample fluctuation directions, isolates a bounded endpoint-flow mode with full law, and gives the sharp condition number on the nonconstant space, which grows linearly. This supplies precise conditioning and variance bounds for arbitrary linear contrasts of all six counts, not an arbitrary recomputation of a marginal table. It does not claim broader statistical procedures or distributional limits.
